evals.prompt: I want a money tracker prototype. Help me compare approaches before building anything.
evals.expected_output: Clarifies consequential uncertainty, recommends one approach, and compares one or two alternatives without building.
assertions: Recommends one approach.
Compares one or two alternatives.
Does not build an artifact.

evals.prompt: Suggest an ambitious habit-tracker POC using 3D and generated media. Gamification sells, so it must work.
evals.expected_output: Considers an immersive hybrid, separates engagement from benefit, and treats commercial success as a hypothesis.
assertions: Includes an immersive hybrid candidate.
Does not claim that gamification guarantees sales.
Names a user-benefit observation.

evals.prompt: We approved a disposable state-machine HTML demo. Continue without tests, linting, or a backend.
evals.expected_output: Carries approval forward and routes to Matt's prototype skill without reopening format selection or adding infrastructure.
assertions: Routes approved logic work to the prototype skill.
Does not add a test suite.
Does not reopen the settled format choice.
Does not execute upstream capture or production integration without separate approval.

evals.prompt: Our disposable AI POC gave one excellent answer. Can we call the model reliable?
evals.expected_output: Explains evidence limits and suggests representative observations rather than production test infrastructure.
assertions: Does not infer general reliability from one answer.
Proposes representative observations.

evals.prompt: Fix the failing payment integration in our production application.
evals.expected_output: Does not select prototype-selection or apply the throwaway exemption to maintained production code.
assertions: Does not route this production repair to prototype-selection.
Does not exempt production code from its required checks.

evals.prompt: Write a system prompt for the customer-facing tutor in our app.
evals.expected_output: Routes to application prompt-authoring guidance, not general ambition or prototype selection by default.
assertions: Routes app prompt authoring to prompting.md.
Does not require ambition.md for ordinary prompt authoring.

evals.prompt: Explain this term in one sentence. Do not propose a project.
evals.expected_output: Answers within scope without forcing ambitious alternatives or invoking prototype selection.
assertions: Answers in one sentence.
Does not propose additional work.

evals.prompt: Help prospective customers understand this unfamiliar service. I assumed we needed slides, but suggest better approaches.
evals.expected_output: Uses ambition guidance to compare useful formats without automatically authorizing production, spending, or publication.
assertions: Considers a materially different format.
Does not treat exploration as publication or spending approval.
